info.name: Sales Order Management API
info.description: API collection for the Sales Order Management assignment. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to the deployed backend URL (e.g. https://sales-order-api.onrender.com) or http://localhost:3000 for local development.

request.description: Creates a sales order, saves it in PostgreSQL and triggers a Firebase notification to all registered devices. `status` is optional (defaults to PENDING; one of PENDING, CONFIRMED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED).
Returns all orders sorted by creation date, newest first.
Registers a Firebase Cloud Messaging device token. The frontend calls this automatically after the browser grants notification permission.
